outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, then closes the gripper around it (frames 70–80, wrist_image). The upper drawer visibly slides outward during frames 86–103 (image and left_ego_image). The robot releases and withdraws, leaving the drawer open through frame 129 (left_ego_image and wrist_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
